entities.summary: Cypriot, a notable figure in the history of Cyprus, associated with Iron Age City-Kingdoms (1050 BCE–333 BCE). Preceded by Ionian Revolt. Their legacy influenced Cypriot kingdoms submit to Assyria under Sargon II and Cypriot cities join the Ionian Revolt against Persia.
